comments.text:
This is a good video, but misses some key things:
1. Tesla fundamentally believes that higher intelligence in the car is more important than more sensors or sensor fusion. The reason it feels this way is pertinent. With multiple types of sensors, they often provide conflicting information and then you now have to divert processing power to deciding which is right. This is inherently dangerous.

2. The issue of profitability is CORE to viability and sustainability. Waymo has absolutely no path to scaled profitability in its current form.

3. This video makes no mention of Chinese efforts in the space, whats available and its efficacy. Or that there are chinese operators who have endorsed a vision only approach.

4. This video does not speak to FSD, and the absolutel rapid and massive adoption seen in the last 3 months, amd the fact that that familiarization would directly impact robotaxi uptake.

5. The video never mentions the cost of a robotaxi vs waymo, how its produced, the mindset behind scalability. It is stark. Estimates are that a cybercab from Tesla is $25000 to $30000 complete. Nor does this indicate that Tesla rides are already charging less oer mile as a result. 

Good video, but it truly doesnt provide a comprehensive understanding of the situation.

comments.text:
This video appears poorly researched or biased. Since the Model Y Juniper refresh in approximately June 2025, Tesla vehicles have been readily available for test drives across the United States. Visiting any Tesla location typically allows customers to take a car or truck for several hours.

Regarding autonomy, Tesla’s Full Self-Driving (Supervised) does not impose the same hard operational limits as Waymo. Waymo remains restricted to specific cities and has not yet validated driverless operation in snow; it also pauses service when conditions fall outside its design domain. Tesla FSD, by contrast, can be engaged in rain, snow, fog, and at night on the broader road network. Performance may degrade in low-visibility ( speed limit it does not stop ) conditions but the system is not barred from operating in those environments the way Waymo’s current robotaxi service is.
